summary: Prototype rules pass the defined six-group emulator suite: verified Google allowlist, private ACL, bounded queries, strict schemas, immutable identity and timestamps, owner-only mutation, and parent-room checks. This is an internal assessment, not an independent audit or guarantee.
limitations: Authorized users may exhaust free quotas; no server-side rate limiting
Ciphertext validity cannot be verified by the server
Account and deployment-code integrity remain trust boundaries
